name: City Car Racer 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: City Car Racer is a fun and exciting driving game in which you must race through a series of busy city streets and try to avoid the oncoming traffic! Drive your car down the roads and weave in and out of the other vehicles - try to take minimal damage and avoid any huge collisions otherwise your car will explode!
